title: Export selected song previews as WAV
changes: Render the selected bounded song or track preview to a downloadable 32 kHz stereo 16-bit WAV using the current timing, voice, envelope, track-control and mute settings.
Capture export settings at launch, share note and mix preparation with live playback, and report unavailable rendering and automation limits.
validation: Synthetic Chrome unit zwqbzr4d passed 42 audio/regression checks including real offline stereo, pan/mutes and live-versus-offline scheduling; 9vk7mg2l passed three focused checks including unavailable-renderer recovery.

Protected EUR e336 unit rb20l36j exported and independently decoded song 312 with eight PCM notes, verified track-mute silence, preserved ten scope payloads and 145 resource pages, and matched 16 Docker/Python outputs. Eleven local wiki pages were published.
limitations: The WAV shares the existing preview limits and approximations; physical audio, exact game mixer behavior and Windows remain unverified.
